decisions.reason: As an incremental extension of the firm's established construction equipment range that still had its own product page in 2024, it likely fits the core portfolio and supports the firm's customer-specific machinery business.
This articulated construction dumper builds directly on the firm's existing offer and remained actively marketed on its own page in 2024, which suggests sufficient strategic and commercial relevance.

Although technically related to underground applications, it was more distant from the core range and was reduced from a dedicated page in 2023 to only a website mention in 2024, indicating weaker traction or lower priority for a medium-sized specialist manufacturer.
The compact telescopic loader is close to the firm's established strengths and its continued full presentation in 2024 points to ongoing commitment and likely market acceptance.

The product is close to the established offer and the website reported that it was the most popular rental material lift for many years and linked it to a major order, which is a strong market signal.

Despite being more distant from the core range, the dedicated 2024 product page and strong early operating data of 1,000 hours in seven months indicate promising customer acceptance worth developing further.
